sources_read: .qc-cache/kittle-2026-10-09-r9/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx: Quality Checks row 26 (#25 judge_prompts_drive_the_browser), Internal Quality Checks row 26, Deterministic Checks C28 (prompt opens localhost URL)
evidence: All five prompts open with 'Evaluate the live application at http://localhost:3000 using Playwright MCP' (gates/render/prompt.md:1, gates/constraints/prompt.md:1, scored/functional/prompt.md:1, scored/polish/prompt.md:1; scored/visual/prompt.md:1-2 'Evaluate the rendered application at http://localhost:3000 using Playwright MCP'), and every judge.toml declares the playwright-mcp stdio server (headless, isolated, pinned /usr/local/bin/chromium); each prompt resolves {app_context} and {criteria}. Source/memory scoring is steered away: render:2 'Use only rendered browser behavior', constraints:2 'browser-visible behavior and browser network evidence only', polish:4 'Judge the rendered product and interactions, not code style', visual:10-16 rendered presentation only, functional:23-28 'passes only on evidence you gathered in this session ... never pass a criterion on a general impression', functional:40-47/54 rendered controls, recorded in-page replays, never curl/shell; all prompts treat submitted source as untrusted. First-paint guesses are excluded: scored prompts restate a gate where 'a first-paint imitation does not pass' (functional:11-19, polish:10-18, visual:18-26), the constraints gate requires posting JUDGE-G1, reload, and readback from harriet in a separate context, and all 26 scored criteria are multi-step browser scripts (post/edit/delete/record-replay/reload/second context/restart_app/resize) whose outcomes cannot be known from reading server.js or the seed. Adversarial probes: a static or seeded-looking shell that renders the right matter titles fails the constraints gate (no server-backed cross-context readback); a judge reading /app/server.js could not learn JUDGE-* post outcomes, live-update timing or restart readback without running them. Conforming alternatives are not penalised by the browser direction: any route/payload/cookie name is accepted (functional:62), matter list beside or on its own screen is accepted (visual matter_sidebar), clipboard-only copy-link and native confirm dialogs are handled in app_context.md:25-26. Task changes vs template only add browser-specific gate/discipline text; test.sh is byte-identical to the template. Limit (not a defect of this row): raw-evidence-index.json states no full configured judge run exists for these bytes, so actual GLM judge tool use of the browser is unmeasured; that gap belongs to the runtime/verifier-launch rows. The template-controlled judge environment could technically read /app, but no prompt invites it and functional/polish/visual prompts forbid substituting evidence.
